name: Supacchu! ~Ikaga ni Watashi ga Hakimono o Aisuru You ni Natta no ka~
original_name: すぱっちゅ！～如何に私がはきものを愛するようになったのか～
source:
Main character loves spats worn by girls. His female childhood friend understands his passion and is ready to do anything for him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公最喜欢女孩穿紧身运动裤的模样。他的青梅竹马古间蓝理解这份热情，愿意为他做任何事。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
